messages:
olivia: FYI customer C-332 hit a billing regression — invoice shows a -$120 line after we tried to apply a promo. They included their request, and our router called modify_line_item instead of apply_discount.
kevin: ouch. any quick logs or payloads to share?
olivia: pasted the incoming tool dispatch payload below — looks like both tools accept an 'amount' field, router matched on that and chose modify_line_item.

olivia: ```json
{
  \"intent\": \"apply discount\",
  \"args\": {
    \"invoice_id\": \"inv_8a2f\",
    \"discount_code\": \"SPRING23\",
    \"amount\": -120
  }
}
```

jordan: so the customer asked for a discount but we mutated the line item instead (negative line item). Did support revert?
olivia: yes — manually reverted the line item and re-ran apply_discount through the admin UI. Customer made whole. But reproducible via API.
support-bot: Created INC-8791 for tracking — priority set to high by reporter.
kevin: repro steps pls so I can write a test.
olivia: steps:
1) Call /v1/tools/dispatch with intent 'apply discount' and args as above.
2) Router returns tool: modify_line_item
3) modify_line_item applies a delta and ends up creating negative line item record.

olivia: curl repro snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/tools/dispatch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"intent":"apply discount","args":{"invoice_id":"inv_8a2f","discount_code":"SPRING23","amount":-120}}'
```

kevin: looks like the router matching is weighted heavily on shared arg names and number of params. Two immediate mitigation ideas:
- prefer tools whose name or docstring contains tokens from the intent (e.g., 'discount')
- if discount_code present prefer apply_discount even if amount exists

jordan: also noticed schema types: apply_discount.discount_code is string optional, modify_line_item.amount is number required. Router currently prefers required-field matches which caused this.
kevin: plan: add a rule that boosts tools with an explicit semantic match on intent tokens, and special-case discount_code -> apply_discount. I'll add a unit test + e2e.
ops-oncall: patch rolling to staging now, will monitor failing rate for dispatch route. tagging infra for canary.
olivia: thanks — please add a migration note so we don't regresses when we change the selector.
kevin: assigning PR to myself — will link INC-8791 and post a short postmortem after fix is live.
ops-oncall: staging patch applied, running smoke tests.
kevin: pushed fix branch with tests, prepping release notes.
olivia: appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
